partitionNote: The single Virginia track is blocked. Virginia circuit-court expungement runs on Supreme Court of Virginia forms and one demonstrably exists for the adjacent subsection, so drafting a custom subsection (B) petition would either replicate an unretrieved official form or invent an instrument for a route the state may already have formalised.

tracks.legalName: Petition for Expungement Where Another Person Used the Petitioner's Identity, Va. Code § 19.2-392.2(B)
tracks.note: Blocked on an unresolved official-form question. The only Virginia expungement form obtained, CC-1473, is captioned to § 19.2-392.2(A) alone and does not cover this subsection; other circuit-court expungement forms returned HTTP 404 from the official library on 2026-08-06. Whether a subsection (B) form exists, and whether the subsection (H) misidentification motion has its own instrument, are both unknown.
